Aladdin is BlackRock’s end-to-end investment platform, supporting investment management, trading, operations, accounting, and risk workflows across the investment lifecycle. The team works in close partnership with engineering and data specialists to solve complex financial technology challenges and expand Aladdin’s artificial intelligence capabilities.

This analyst role sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) development, technology delivery, and client partnership. You will contribute to the delivery of complex technology solutions and large-scale initiatives, take ownership of critical workstreams, and help influence product strategy. The role is well suited to someone who can translate client challenges into engineering solutions, collaborate effectively across disciplines, and solve complex problems at scale.

- Platform strategy and architecture
